newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-CELTIC CHASE HAMBURG GOALKEEPER GOLZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC CHASE HAMBURG GOALKEEPER GOLZ.

text.p: Glasgow Celtic are interested in signing German goalkeeper Richard Golz, who is out of favour with Bundesliga club Hamburg.
Hamburg general manager Bernd Wehmeyer said on Thursday Celtic had made an official inquiry about Golz. "We'll have a look in peace and quiet and then we'll speak to the Scots," he said.
Golz, who has been with Hamburg since 1985, has been demoted to the bench since the arrival of new coach Frank Pagelsdorf in the close season.
Pagelsdorf has installed Hans-Joerg Butt, a new signing from VfB Oldenburg, as his number one.
"I know Celtic are interested. I'd go there straight away," Golz was quoted as saying in the Bild daily.

Press reports said Celtic, under pressure to conclude the deal before Friday's European transfer deadline, were prepared to pay five million marks ($2.7 million) for Golz, who has a contract with the northern German club until the year 2000.
